name: inquisitive-magician-enter-reveals-two-mage-cards-for-an-enlighten-counter
notes: Inquisitive Magician On Enter: reveal two Mage cards (two Convergent Beams) from hand/memory for an enlighten counter. Pre-fix choosing the first card was a fatal (undefined $mageCards).

rulesClauses: On Enter: You may reveal two Mage cards from your hand and/or memory. If you do, put an enlighten counter on your champion.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The Enter-1 handler filtered the undefined $mageCards (defined only in the enter body): array_filter(null) was a fatal. The handler is overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php and rebuilds the remaining Mage cards from the hand and memory.
